scripts.dev: pnpm run dev:prepare && concurrently --kill-others --names protocol,server,worker,app --prefix-colors gray,blue,magenta,green "pnpm --filter @cantrip/protocol dev" "pnpm --filter @cantrip/server dev" "node scripts/wait-for-server.mjs && pnpm --filter @cantrip/worker dev" "node scripts/wait-for-server.mjs && pnpm --filter @cantrip/app dev"
scripts.devtop: pnpm run dev:prepare && concurrently --kill-others --names protocol,server,worker,desktop --prefix-colors gray,blue,magenta,green "pnpm --filter @cantrip/protocol dev" "pnpm --filter @cantrip/server dev" "node scripts/wait-for-server.mjs && pnpm --filter @cantrip/worker dev" "node scripts/wait-for-server.mjs && pnpm --filter @cantrip/app tauri:dev"
scripts.dev:postgres: pnpm run dev:prepare && cross-env DATABASE_URL=postgresql://cantrip:cantrip@127.0.0.1:54329/cantrip concurrently --kill-others --names database,protocol,server,worker,app --prefix-colors yellow,gray,blue,magenta,green "docker compose -f compose.dev.yml up" "pnpm --filter @cantrip/protocol dev" "pnpm --filter @cantrip/server dev" "node scripts/wait-for-server.mjs && pnpm --filter @cantrip/worker dev" "node scripts/wait-for-server.mjs && pnpm --filter @cantrip/app dev"
